question: If the mode of a data set exceeds its mean by 37.8, then the mode exceeds the median by _____. (Use empirical formula.)
solution: __Shortcut Trick__ The relationship between **Mean**, **Median**, and **Mode** is defined by the ratio of their differences. Using the empirical formula: (Mode − Median) = 2/3 × (Mode − Mean) Given: (Mode − Mean) = 37.8 Calculation: (Mode − Median) = 2/3 × 37.8 = 2 × 12.6 = 25.2 **∴ The correct answer is 25.2.** **__Alternate Method__** Given: **Mode − Mean = 37.8** Formula Used: **Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mean** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0923f82fe7e6a865f7c25b10254933ed1abf42639f8e9e7e5198370226e65562.png] ⇒ Mode − Mean = 37.8 ⇒ Mean = Mode − 37.8 ⇒ Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × (Mode − 37.8) ⇒ Mode = 3 × Median − 2 × Mode + 75.6 ⇒ 3 × Mode − 3 × Median = 75.6 ⇒ 3(Mode − Median) = 75.6 ⇒ Mode − Median = 75.6 ÷ 3 = 25.2 **∴ The correct answer is 25.2.** **__Additional Information__**
